description: Owner-side ban barring an account from a group. Lives in a group admin/owner's repo. The AppView treats a ban as the highest-precedence moderation signal: a banned DID is excluded from the member list and timeline and cannot post, regardless of any membership or invite record. Unban == delete this record.

group.description: Strong reference to the com.authorityone.group.profile this ban applies to.

subject.description: DID of the account being banned.
